highlights: Cleans pool floor, walls, waterline and surface; includes water clarification
HybridSense AI Vision supports detection of debris and navigation
Separate AstroRinse station washes the filter with a rotating water nozzle after docking
Voice integrations are described for use outside the pool or at the water surface
Users place AquaSense X on the AstroRinse station after cleaning. Its automatic three-minute filter backwash starts once docked; autonomous travel from the pool onto the station is not established.

The 22 L waste bin and up-to-two-month emptying claim belong to the station, under the announcement’s two-cycles-per-week condition. They are not the robot basket volume or a guaranteed maintenance-free interval.

The current US page limits app control to the water surface and rates saltwater compatibility up to 5000 ppm. Its shallow-platform claim starts at 35 cm water depth; none of these values establishes underwater connectivity, ingress certification or robot dimensions.

companyFocus.reviewNotes: Batch136. Seven successful native HTML responses plus one recorded HTTP429; all response hashes checked. Requests to beatbot.com stopped after 429, no regional-host workaround. Exact manufacturer release scopes retained. X and Sora30 old rows/media/IDs retained; Sora70, Sora10 and named Aquatic RoboTurtle added. AstroRinse, filters, clarifier kits, covers, bags and multi-robot bundles are not extra robot rows. Three-minute wash/two-month waste-bin interval are not operating or charging duration; robot requires placement on station. No image-only numbers imported. Sora30 runtime is not copied to Sora10; Sora70 IP/dimensions/mass are not shared. GPH is flow, not travel speed; basket litres not payload; pool area per charge not area per hour. RoboTurtle is a demonstrated research prototype, not retail availability or separately named2025/2026 model generations. Historic MSRP dated; universal coverage, world-first, awards, patent totals, clinical/chemical safety, current stock and historical completeness not independently verified. Other existing Beatbot models remain separately pending; the two-field iSkim review is preserved.
